review_notes.credit_policy: Reference-alignment credit: substantive criterion recognition earns points; generic good/bad headings alone do not. Correct partial insights receive credit before separately documenting errors.
review_notes.deduction_policy: Primary: at most one deduction per response paragraph. Sensitivity: one per documented material error instance. Repeated versions of the same claim within a paragraph count once; repeated claims in different paragraph evaluations count separately. No deductions for style, formatting, repetition alone, or absent thinking tags.
review_notes.scope_policy: Original paragraphs 3 and 8: explicitly record the required missing scope qualification once each. Other missing criteria earn zero/partial credit without an extra omission deduction.
review_notes.negative_score_policy: No zero-floor, as predeclared in the supplied evaluator before generation. Negative points are rubric penalties, not negative ability or a probability.
review_notes.capability_claim: Some successful critical-thinking behaviors, but unreliable overall argument evaluation in this run. No binary capability certificate or claim about faithful internal thinking.
